[element-fig-group]
=== `<fig-group>` Figure Group

Container element for figures that are to be displayed together.

#### Related Elements

Both figures (<<element-fig,`<fig>`>>) and graphics (<<element-graphic,`<graphic>`>>) may appear either grouped within a <<element-fig-group,`<fig-group>`>> or singly within textual material.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
* <<attribute-orientation,`@orientation`>> (default = portrait)
* <<attribute-originator,`@originator`>>
* <<attribute-position,`@position`>> (default = float)
* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>

#### Description

The following, in order: <<element-label,`<label>`>> <<element-label,Label of a Figure, Reference, Etc.>>, zero or one <<element-caption,`<caption>`>> <<element-caption,Caption of a Figure, Table, Etc.>>, zero or one <<element-legend,`<legend>`>> <<element-legend,Legend>>, zero or more <<element-abstract,`<abstract>`>> <<element-abstract,Abstract>>, zero or more <<element-kwd-group,`<kwd-group>`>> <<element-kwd-group,Keyword Group>>, zero or more <<element-subj-group,`<subj-group>`>> <<element-subj-group,Subject Group>>, zero or more Any combination of: Accessibility Elements <<element-alt-text,`<alt-text>`>> <<element-alt-text,Alternate Title Text For a Figure, Etc.>> <<element-long-desc,`<long-desc>`>> <<element-long-desc,Long Description>> External Linking Elements <<element-email,`<email>`>> <<element-email,Email Address>> <<element-ext-link,`<ext-link>`>> <<element-ext-link,External Link>> <<element-uri,`<uri>`>> <<element-uri,Uniform Resource Identifier (URI)>> Any combination of: <<element-fig,`<fig>`>> <<element-fig,Figure>> <<element-alternatives,`<alternatives>`>> <<element-alternatives,Alternatives For Processing>> <<element-graphic,`<graphic>`>> <<element-graphic,Graphic>> <<element-media,`<media>`>> <<element-media,Media Object>>
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  fig-group    %fig-group-model;                            >
....
#### Expanded Content Model

((label)?, (caption)?, (legend)*, (abstract)*, (kwd-group)*, (subj-group)*, (alt-text | long-desc | email | ext-link | uri)*, (fig | alternatives | graphic | media)*)

#### Tagged Sample

##### Note captions for both `<fig-group>` and `<fig>`
[source,xml]
....
...
<fig-group id="overview4">
 <caption><title>Figures 12-14 Overview Diagrams</title>
  <p>Diagrams of the mechanizm from three perspectives</p>
 </caption>

 <fig id="fg-12">
  <label>a.</label>
  <caption><p>View A: From the Front</p></caption>
  <graphic xlink:href="frontView.png"/>
 </fig>

 <fig id="fg-13">
  <label>b.</label>
  <caption><p>View B: From the Side</p></caption>
  <graphic xlink:href="sideView.png"/>
 </fig>

 <fig id="fg-14">
  <label>c.</label>
  <caption><p>View C: From Above</p></caption>
  <graphic xlink:href="topView.png"/>
 </fig>

</fig-group>
...
....
